slides.title: Unless, as long as, in case
slides.subtitle: Other conditional linkers
goals: Use **as long as / provided that** = only if.

slides.title: Meanings

head: Linker
Meaning
Example
rows: I won't go **unless** you come with me.
You can borrow it **as long as** you return it.
Take an umbrella **in case** it rains.

slides.watch: *In case* ≠ *if*. *Take an umbrella **if** it rains* = only when it rains. *Take an umbrella **in case** it rains* = take it now, just in case.

items.q: I'll lend you my car ___ you drive carefully.
Write down my number ___ you get lost.

items.t: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus. → You'll miss the bus ___ you hurry.
I'll take some snacks ___ we get hungry. (por si acaso)
